act_revisions.epistemic_purpose: Causal discriminator → bounded exactly-once repair for the deferred duplicate-completion-presentation defect. P1 review feedback addressed: predicate narrowed to conjunctive fingerprint.

architecture.duplicate_layer: Presentation — translateSessionEvent pending_prompt_submitted branch at apps/vscode/src/sdk/message-translator.ts:2303-2332 renders the wake prompt as a user_feedback row when isSyntheticUserPrompt returns false

p1_correction.issue: First-pass predicate matched `<bounded-output>` OR `</bounded-output>` alone, which would have hidden legitimate user prompts containing either delimiter (e.g., a user explaining HTML/XML).
p1_correction.reviewer_source: factory causal reviewer / ClineMM presentation/runtime engineer
p1_correction.fix: Narrowed predicate to conjunctive fingerprint: formatter-owned prefix AND both bounded-output delimiters. The prefix is exported as `BACKGROUND_TERMINAL_WAKE_PROMPT_PREFIX` from `apps/vscode/src/sdk/background-notify-coordinator.ts` (single-source-of-truth); `formatTerminalWakePrompt` now references the same constant.
p1_correction.single_source_of_truth: apps/vscode/src/sdk/background-notify-coordinator.ts:52-67 — the prefix literal lives in exactly one place; the formatter's `head` array references the constant; the synthetic-prompt predicate references the same constant.
